verses.sloka: अवाङ्मुखमथो दीनं दृष्ट्वा सोममिवाप्लुतम् ।राघवं लक्ष्मणो वाक्यं हृष्टो मधुरमब्रवीत् ।। ७.१०६.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: avāṅmukhamatho dīnaṁ dṛṣṭvā somamivāplutam ।rāghavaṁ lakṣmaṇo vākyaṁ hṛṣṭo madhuramabravīt ।। 7.106.1 ॥

translations.english: Seeing Rama with his face downcast and distressed, like the moon submerged in sorrow, Lakshmana, with a firm resolve, spoke gentle words to him.
translations.hindi: उत्तरकाण्ड का अद्वासीवाँ सग पूरा हुआ । --:६9०:-- एकोननवतितमः सगः >>>:०:-77 श्रत्वा किंपुरुषोत्पत्ति लक्ष्मणो भरतस्तथा । आश्चर्यमिति च व्रृतामुभौ रामं जनेश्वरम्‌

verses.sloka: न संतापं महाबाहो मदर्थं कर्तुमर्हसि ।पूर्वनिर्माणबद्धा हि कालस्य गतिरीदृशी ।। ७.१०६.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: na saṁtāpaṁ mahābāho madarthaṁ kartumarhasi ।pūrvanirmāṇabaddhā hi kālasya gatirīdṛśī ।। 7.106.2 ॥

translations.english: O mighty-armed one, you should not grieve for my sake, for such is indeed the course of time, bound by preordained destiny.

verses.sloka: जहि मां सौम्य विस्रब्धं प्रतिज्ञां परिपालय ।हीनप्रतिज्ञाः काकुत्स्थ प्रयान्ति नरकं नराः ।। ७.१०६.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: jahi māṁ saumya visrabdhaṁ pratijñāṁ paripālaya ।hīnapratijñāḥ kākutstha prayānti narakaṁ narāḥ ।। 7.106.3 ॥

translations.english: O gentle one, confidently abandon me and fulfill your vow, for men who fail in their promises, O Kakutstha, go to hell.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी बोले ) बुध ने अन्य समस्त किन्नरियो को बिचरण करते देख, (एकान्त में इला को पा कर) उस रूप योबनसम्पन्ना इला से हंस कर कहा,

verses.sloka: यदि प्रीतिर्महाराज यद्यनुग्राह्यता मयि ।जहि मां निर्विशङ्कस्त्वं धर्मं वर्धय राघव ।। ७.१०६.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi prītirmahārāja yadyanugrāhyatā mayi ।jahi māṁ nirviśaṅkastvaṁ dharmaṁ vardhaya rāghava ।। 7.106.4 ॥

translations.english: O great king, if there is affection and favor towards me, then abandon me without hesitation, O Raghava, and uphold your dharma.
translations.hindi: हे वरारोद्दे ! मैं चन्द्रमा का प्रिय पुत्र हूँ । प्यार की दृष्टि से मेरी ओर निहार कर, तू मुझे प्रोतिपूवेक सन्तुष्ट कर

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणेन तथोक्तस्तु रामः प्रचलितेन्द्रियः ।मन्त्रिणः समुपानीय तथैव च पुरोधसम् ।। ७.१०६.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇena tathoktastu rāmaḥ pracalitendriyaḥ ।mantriṇaḥ samupānīya tathaiva ca purodhasam ।। 7.106.5 ॥

translations.english: Thus spoken to by Lakshmana, Rama, with his senses greatly disturbed, summoned his ministers and similarly his chief priest.
translations.hindi: कामासक्त ब्रुध को उस सुन्दरी इला के साथ बिद्दार करते करते वैशाख मास क्षण सा बीत गया

verses.sloka: अब्रवीच्च तदा वृत्तं तेषां मध्ये स राघवः ।दुर्वासोभिगमं चैव प्रतिज्ञां तापसस्य च ।। ७.१०६.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: abravīcca tadā vṛttaṁ teṣāṁ madhye sa rāghavaḥ ।durvāsobhigamaṁ caiva pratijñāṁ tāpasasya ca ।। 7.106.6 ॥

translations.english: Then, in their midst, Rama recounted the incident, including the arrival of Durvasa and the ascetic's vow.
translations.hindi: हे सौम्य ! में स्वतंत्र हूँ थोर तुम्हारे वश में हूँ । हे चन्द्रपुन ! मुझे आज्ञा दीजिए और जैसा चाहिए बैसा कीजिए

verses.sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा मन्त्रिणः सर्वे सोपाध्यायाः समासत ।वसिष्ठस्तु महातेजा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। ७.१०६.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā mantriṇaḥ sarve sopādhyāyāḥ samāsata ।vasiṣṭhastu mahātejā vākyametaduvāca ha ।। 7.106.7 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that, all the ministers, along with their preceptors, assembled, and then the greatly effulgent Vasishtha spoke these words.
translations.hindi: इला के इन अदूभुत वचनों को सुन, बुध बहुत प्रसन्न हुए और कामी चन्द्रमापुत्र बुघ, इला के साथ विहार करने लगे

verses.sloka: दृष्टमेतन्महाबाहो क्षयं ते रोमहर्षणम् ।लक्ष्मणेन वियोगश्च तव राम महायशः ।। ७.१०६.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭametanmahābāho kṣayaṁ te romaharṣaṇam ।lakṣmaṇena viyogaśca tava rāma mahāyaśaḥ ।। 7.106.8 ॥

translations.english: O mighty-armed and greatly renowned Rama, this terrifying destruction and your separation from Lakshmana have been foreseen.

verses.sloka: त्यजैनं बलवान्कालो मा प्रतिज्ञां वृथा कृताः ।विनष्टायां प्रतिज्ञायां धर्मो ऽपि च लयं व्रजेत् ।। ७.१०६.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: tyajainaṁ balavānkālo mā pratijñāṁ vṛthā kṛtāḥ ।vinaṣṭāyāṁ pratijñāyāṁ dharmo 'pi ca layaṁ vrajet ।। 7.106.9 ॥

translations.english: Abandon him, for time is powerful; do not let your vow be made in vain, because if the vow is violated, even righteousness will meet its dissolution.

verses.sloka: ततो धर्मे विनष्टे तु त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ।सदेवर्षिगणं सर्वं विनश्येत्तु न संशयः ।। ७.१०६.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: tato dharme vinaṣṭe tu trailokyaṁ sacarācaram ।sadevarṣigaṇaṁ sarvaṁ vinaśyettu na saṁśayaḥ ।। 7.106.10 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, if righteousness is destroyed, then without a doubt, all three worlds, including all moving and non-moving beings, along with the groups of gods and sages, would also be destroyed.

verses.sloka: स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल त्रैलोक्यस्याभिपालनात् ।लक्ष्मणेन विना चाद्य जगत्स्वस्थं कुरुष्व ह ।। ७.१०६.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tvaṁ puruṣaśārdūla trailokyasyābhipālanāt ।lakṣmaṇena vinā cādya jagatsvasthaṁ kuruṣva ha ।। 7.106.11 ॥

translations.english: O tiger among men, for the protection of the three worlds, you must now make the world stable even without Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: हे भगवन्‌ ! में अपनी सेना को साथ लेकर, इस दुर्गम पवत पर आया था, किन्तु यहाँ उनमें से सुमे कोई नहीं देख पढ़ता. वे मेरे साथी कहाँ चले गए ?

verses.sloka: तेषां तत्समवेतानां वाक्यं धर्मार्थसंहितम् ।श्रुत्वा परिषदो मध्ये रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत् ।। ७.१०६.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: teṣāṁ tatsamavetānāṁ vākyaṁ dharmārthasaṁhitam ।śrutvā pariṣado madhye rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt ।। 7.106.12 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words full of righteousness and purpose from those assembled in the midst of the council, Rama spoke to Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: राजर्षि इल के, जो अपने खीभाव को भूल गए थे बचन, सुन कर, बुध उनको सममाते हुए उनसे सुन्दर वाणी से बोले

verses.sloka: विसर्जये त्वां सौमित्रे मा भूद्धर्मविपर्ययः ।त्यागो वधो वा विहितः साधूनां तूभयं समम् ।। ७.१०६.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: visarjaye tvāṁ saumitre mā bhūddharmaviparyayaḥ ।tyāgo vadho vā vihitaḥ sādhūnāṁ tūbhayaṁ samam ।। 7.106.13 ॥

translations.english: O son of Sumitra, I shall abandon you, lest there be a transgression of dharma, for abandonment or killing is prescribed, and for the virtuous, both are considered equal.
translations.hindi: पत्थरों की बढ़ी भारी वर्षा हुई थी। उससे तुम्हारे सब सैनिक | मरे पड़े हें । वायु ओर बृष्टि के भय से पीड़ित हो, तुम इस आश्रम में सो जाने से बच गए

verses.sloka: रामेण भाषिते वाक्ये बाष्पव्याकुलितेन्द्रियः ।लक्ष्मणस्त्वरितं प्रायात्स्वगृहं न विवेश ह ।। ७.१०६.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: rāmeṇa bhāṣite vākye bāṣpavyākulitendriyaḥ ।lakṣmaṇastvaritaṁ prāyātsvagṛhaṁ na viveśa ha ।। 7.106.14 ॥

translations.english: When these words were spoken by Rama, Lakshmana, whose senses were agitated by tears, quickly departed and indeed did not enter his own house.
translations.hindi: एकोननव तितमः सग; ५०१: हे वीर ! अब तुम साबधान और निर्भय हो जाभो। किसी बात की चिन्ता न इरो ओर फल मूल खा कर, इस आश्रम में रहो

verses.sloka: स गत्वा सरयूतीरमुपस्पृश्य कृताञ्जलिः ।निगृह्य सर्वस्रोतांसि निःश्वासं न मुमोच ह ।। ७.१०६.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa gatvā sarayūtīramupaspṛśya kṛtāñjaliḥ ।nigṛhya sarvasrotāṁsi niḥśvāsaṁ na mumoca ha ।। 7.106.15 ॥

translations.english: Having gone to the bank of the Sarayu, he performed ritual purification, folded his hands in reverence, and restraining all his vital breaths, he indeed did not release a single exhalation.
translations.hindi: राजा इल अपने नौऊरों का नाश होना सुन कर, बहुत दुःखी हुए ; किन्तु बुध की बातों से सावधान हो कर बोले

verses.sloka: अनिःश्वसन्तं युक्तं तं सशक्राः साप्सरोगणाः ।देवाः सर्षिगणाः सर्वे पुष्पैरभ्यकिरंस्तदा ।। ७.१०६.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: aniḥśvasantaṁ yuktaṁ taṁ saśakrāḥ sāpsarogaṇāḥ ।devāḥ sarṣigaṇāḥ sarve puṣpairabhyakiraṁstadā ।। 7.106.16 ॥

translations.english: Then, all the gods, along with Indra, groups of Apsaras, and groups of sages, showered flowers upon him (Lakshmana), who was absorbed (in his divine form) and had ceased breathing.

verses.sloka: अदृश्यं सर्वमनुजैः सशरीरं महाबलम् ।प्रगृह्य लक्ष्मणं शक्रस्त्रिदिवं संविवेश ह ।। ७.१०६.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: adṛśyaṁ sarvamanujaiḥ saśarīraṁ mahābalam ।pragṛhya lakṣmaṇaṁ śakrastridivaṁ saṁviveśa ha ।। 7.106.17 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, Indra took the mighty Lakshmana, who was invisible to all humans and still in his physical body, and entered heaven.

verses.sloka: ततो विष्णोश्चतुर्भागमागतं सुरसत्तमाः ।दृष्ट्वा प्रमुदिताः सर्वे ऽपूजयन् समहर्षयः ।। ७.१०६.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato viṣṇoścaturbhāgamāgataṁ surasattamāḥ ।dṛṣṭvā pramuditāḥ sarve 'pūjayan samaharṣayaḥ ।। 7.106.18 ।।

translations.english: Then, having seen the fourth part of Vishnu (Lakshmana) arrive, all the best of gods, along with the great sages, were greatly delighted and worshipped him. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षडुत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 106 ।। Thus ends the hundred and sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: सुखपर्वक देश में बसने वाले अपने उन नोकरों की खिर्यो को छोड़ कर, मैं यहाँ नहीं रद्द सकता । हे तेजस्वी ! तुम मुझसे यइ रहने के लिए अप्रिय बचन मत कहो
